biomarkers.name: KRAS mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common MAPK pathway driver in LGSC; supports MAPK pathway dependence and rationale for MEK inhibitor benefit, although mutation is not required for trametinib activity

biomarkers.name: BRAF mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Less common MAPK pathway driver than KRAS; supports MEK inhibitor rationale

biomarkers.name: NRAS mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Less common MAPK activator in LGSC

biomarkers.name: Trametinib response signature
biomarkers.clinical_use: Trametinib (MEK inhibitor) improved PFS versus standard-of-care in recurrent LGSC in NRG-GOG 281/LOGS; benefit was observed irrespective of MAPK mutation status. Practice-changing standard systemic option in recurrent disease

biomarkers.name: ER, PR
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports use of endocrine therapy; hormonal therapy (for example, letrozole) has clinical activity

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.prevalence: Rare; wild-type p53 pattern is typical in LGSC and helps distinguish from HGSC
biomarkers.clinical_use: Pathogenic TP53 mutation or aberrant p53 pattern should prompt review for high-grade serous carcinoma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Micropapillary and macropapillary architecture with mild-to-moderate nuclear atypia; often arises in serous borderline tumours
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Low-grade by definition (2-tier serous grading system); commonly MAPK-driven

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not well characterised; typically less inflamed than HGSC
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Fibrous/desmoplastic stroma; often associated with invasive peritoneal implants

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Often arises via a serous borderline tumour (atypical proliferative serous tumour) precursor pathway rather than the tubal fimbria pathway typical of HGSC
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Well-differentiated serous (typically WT1+, PAX8+, CK7+, ER+; PR often positive); relatively low proliferation index
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Distinct precursor pathway (SBT → LGSC) with KRAS/BRAF/NRAS and other MAPK-pathway alterations driving tumorigenesis; biologically distinct from HGSC
